_grade: [L] LOCKED external input. These are ordinal FIRST-APPEARANCE Carnegie stages (CS) of human INTERNAL/visceral organ primordia, compiled from standard human-embryology references. They are NEVER adjusted to change a correlation. organ_timing.py treats this table as read-only and tests corr(DNA-derived schedule, observed stage); the table does not depend on gamma in any way.
_provenance: Ordinal first-appearance Carnegie stages compiled from standard references: O'Rahilly R & Muller F, 'Developmental Stages in Human Embryos' (Carnegie Inst. of Washington, Publ. 637, 1987; 2nd ed. 2010); Larsen's Human Embryology (Schoenwolf et al.); Moore, 'The Developing Human'; UNSW Embryology (Hill MA). These are canonical, textbook-stable ORDINAL stages. Exact day estimates are contextual only and are NOT used in the rank-correlation test.
_method: Each visceral primordium below is tagged with the SAME master gene used in organ_atlas.py, restricted to genuine [V] specification masters with a CRISP single first-appearance stage. The model's emergence schedule for these organs is argsort(spinodal(gamma)) -- a pure readout of MEASURED gamma (organ_gamma.json, fetched by the identical NCBI->SantaLucia pipeline). The test reports Spearman rho and Pearson r between the gamma-derived schedule and the observed CS, plus an exact permutation p-value. RANK correlation is used so the result is robust to +/-1-stage encoding uncertainty.
_scope_note: Only crisp-staged [V] masters are included: heart=NKX2-5, liver=HHEX, stomach=BARX1, lung=NKX2-1, pancreas=PDX1, kidney/metanephros=SIX2, spleen=TLX1. The midgut/intestine master CDX2 is deliberately EXCLUDED from the timing test (carried in organ_atlas.py for the emergence geometry only) because intestinal first-appearance is PROGRESSIVE (the gut tube forms over CS10-13 with body folding) and has no crisp single 'intestine at CS X' -- exactly the soft-staging reason MYF5/myotome was excluded from the v8 dev-timing line. HHEX is also expressed in thyroid/forebrain but is the canonical liver-bud specifier; NKX2-1 is the lung AND thyroid master but is locked here for the lung bud. Including more crisp [V] visceral masters with documented staging would tighten the test (see HANDOFF).
_frozen: This table is content-frozen; verify_organ_timing.py check #2 pins its sha256 and asserts the stages are integers independent of the gamma table (not back-fitted).
